title: witheringia schottiana
intro: Witheringia schottiana, commonly known as the "Chachaciero" or "Tropical Yellow Trumpet", is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Witheringia schottiana are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate cough, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health-promoting properties.
